text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] :rotating_light: Pager triggered -> SFO egress packet loss detected via TransitCorp (AS65011). Multiple prefixes showing intermittent packet loss and BGP flap activity. Severity: P1. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/2241. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.example/incidents/transit-egress.

sre_oncall: acknowledged. moving discussion to #incidents. I'm taking lead. pulling BGP adjacency state and flow logs now.

alice.k: seeing spike in 5xx from customers in SFO region, also high tail latency on embeddings API. TR: roughly 03:42 UTC onset.

netops_sam: observability: TransitCorp peer at 203.0.113.5 flapping — AS_PATH changes and withdrawals for 198.51.100.0/22 and 203.0.114.0/23 seen. Packetloss ~20-40% on pings to upstream.

todd_infra: can you paste the bgp show? I'm going to validate RIB.

netops_sam: running quick checks now. output:
```
# show ip bgp neighbors 203.0.113.5 received-routes | tail -n 20
> *> 198.51.100.0/22 203.0.113.5 0 65011 i
*> 203.0.114.0/23 203.0.113.5 0 65011 i

# show bgp neighbor 203.0.113.5 advertised-routes | head
<withdrawn 198.51.100.0/22 multiple times in last 5m>
```

mike_dev: any chance this is a downstream filter or a global routing leak somewhere?

netops_sam: initial looks like partial instability on TransitCorp's edge - multiple prepends/withdrawals. We also see asymmetric paths for some flows (SFO -> egress via TransitCorp, return traffic taking backup via PeerNet).

emily_co: Customer Ops: I've opened an incident notification to top customers in SFO and sent initial advisory. Affected customers: 3 enterprise accounts on dedicated capacity, some self-serve apps. Ticket numbers: #7248, #7251.

sre_oncall: immediate mitigation plan (T-minus):
1) Ask netops to prepend AS path for affected prefixes to prefer BackupTransit (AS65100).
2) Announce /24 more-specifics for critical customer prefixes where applicable.
3) Coordinate with infra to enable transient edge steering (BGP communities).
4) Monitor error rates and rollback if regression.

netops_sam: executing plan item 1 now: applying 3x AS-PATH prepend to announcements towards our IBGP and to the transit session.

incident-bot: Route-update job started by netops_sam at 03:49:12 UTC. Job ID: rtu-20250312-331.

netops_sam: announcing more specifics for the highest-impact prefixes (only for dedicated customers):
```
# bgp announce 198.51.100.128/25 via 10.10.1.2 community 65010:110 no-export
# bgp announce 203.0.114.128/25 via 10.10.1.2 community 65010:110 no-export
```

todd_infra: pushed edge steering changes to egress proxies to prefer BackupTransit for SFO for those prefixes.

mike_dev: confirming metrics: after prepends, packet loss to those prefixes dropped from ~30% to ~4% within 60s. p50/p95 latency improving.

alice.k: p99 still elevated for embeddings for a small % of requests, but overall error rate trending down. continuing to watch.

incident-bot: Automated check: Synthetics for SFO embedding endpoint now 95% success (was 72%). Next check scheduled in 30s.

sre_oncall: good. please keep detailed timestamps of all BGP changes for RCA. netops, can you capture MRTs and export to the incident ticket?

netops_sam: MRT dump in progress. uploading to case: https://incidents.redwood.example/cases/2241/artifacts/mrts.tar.gz

emily_co: sent status update to customers: interim mitigation in place, working with TransitCorp to identify root cause. ETA for full resolution unknown.

sre_oncall: handoff note: I'm going to bring in second on-call for overnight monitoring. leaving a short summary on the incident ticket.

sre_second: joining. ack - I'll keep watch and follow up with TransitCorp peering team. Will open a vendor escalation now.

mike_dev: FYI — DNS lookups are unaffected (authoritative Route53). TTLs are low (60s) but no changes required. This is pure transport/BGP.

todd_infra: quick config snapshot we applied (for audit):
```
# edge policy: prefer-backup-sfo
match prefix-list SFO_CUST
set as-path prepend 65011 65011 65011
set community 65100:100
```

sre_oncall: current status: mitigations applied, majority of traffic now off TransitCorp path for affected prefixes. Customer impact reduced to degraded for a small subset. Waiting for TransitCorp response on root cause.

incident-bot: Ticket updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> P1->P2 (partial). Next review: 04:30 UTC.

emily_co: customers notified about mitigation and that we'll follow up with RCA. logged requests for credit where SLA breach observed.

netops_sam: saving all logs and timestamps. will add community and AS-PATH changes to the change log for postmortem.

alice.k: thanks team. I'll monitor metrics and draft post-incident notes once TransitCorp confirms.

sre_second: taking over active watch. I'll post next update in 30 minutes or on any regressions.

mike_dev: reminder: open action items -> export MRTs, vendor escalation ticket, customer RCA draft, internal postmortem owner.

incident-bot: Incident timeline created: https://incidents.redwood.example/cases/2241/timeline

sre_oncall: closing slack handoff. moving updates to incident ticket for continuity.

sre_second: ack.
